brief:
Israelis voted in record numbers in a wartime election on Tuesday that was widely promoted as a historic turning point, Al-Monitor reported. The high participation rate marked a significant moment in Israeli politics during active conflict.

The vote generated minimal coverage or engagement across the broader Middle East region, according to regional observers and media outlets cited by the outlet.
dek: By Sayed Sheasha , Ahmad Al Kerdi and Dawoud Abu Alkas CAIRO/BEIRUT/GAZA, Oct 28 (Reuters) - Israelis voted in record numbers in Tuesday's wartime election billed as a major turning point in the nation's history.
title: Israel's record election turnout draws little regional attention in Middle East
